mpare this run against a baseline run: per-case status (`regressed`, `fixed`, `new_case`, `removed_case`, `changed`), per-scorer p
ass-rate and mean deltas from the evaluation contract, and whether the evaluation config changed. Omit `baseRunId` to compare agai
nst the nearest earlier **completed**…\n- [List run iterations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-run-iteration
s.md): Per-iteration results: actual tool calls, structured token usage, and latency. Cursor-paginated.\n- [Get an iteration trace
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-iteration-trace.md): Full trace envelope for one iteration: conversation
messages, expected-vs-actual tool call analysis, and spans. The shape is rich and may evolve — treat it as an open document. Retur
ns `404` with `details.reason: \"TRACE_NOT_AVAILABLE\"` when the iteration finished without a stored trace.\n- [Get an iteration's

et tool calls). The fastest way to see which step failed and why. Unlike `/trace`, a missing trace is not a `404` — step verdicts
still ret…\n- [Cancel a run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/cancel-a-run.md): Request cancellation of an in-fligh
t run; marks the run and its pending/running iterations `cancelled`. A run held in `grading` for its gating judge CAN be cancelled
— it lands `cancelled` with no verdict, which is the honest outcome for a run nobody waited out. A no-op success when the run is
alrea…\n- [Preview a failed-cases rerun](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-a-failed-cases-rerun.md): What `P
OST /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/rerun` with `scope: \"failed_cases\"` would execute, before anything spends. The platf
orm selects every case with a trial that is not completed and passed; cancelled and skipped trials do not count. `reasons` and `ex
cluded` count trials; `selectedCase…\n- [Rerun a run's failed cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/rerun-a-runs-
failed-cases.md): Replay a finished run's frozen snapshot narrowed to the cases that did not pass: every case with a trial that is
not completed and passed (cancelled and skipped trials do not count). The platform selects the cases — see the rerun preview. The
new run records `rerunOfRunId` and `rerunScope`, and beca…\n- [List a suite's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-ru
ns/list-a-suites-runs.md): Recent runs for a suite, newest first.\n- [List a suite's per-run stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.
com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-per-run-stage-analytics.md): One materialized stage-analytics document per RUN, newest c
ompletion first: where trials fell out of the six-stage user-value chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, u
ser value), overall and sliced marginally by intent, model and host.\n- [Get one run's stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/ap
i-reference/eval-runs/get-one-runs-stage-analytics.md): ONE run's materialized stage-analytics document: where its trials fell out
of the six-stage user-value chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, user value), overall and sliced margina
lly by intent, model and host.\n- [Get one run's suite quality-gate report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-on
e-runs-suite-quality-gate-report.md): ONE run's stored suite quality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1`): passed, failed, non_gateab
le, or not_configured.\n- [Enable, repoint, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/enable-
repoint-or-disable-a-suites-schedule.md): A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval, so an environment-based suite must pin ex
actly one of its attached environments. Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environment suite means that environment; omitting it
on a multi-environment suite is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…\n- [Launch one run per target as a group (asyn
c)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/launch-one-run-per-target-as-a-group-async.md): Launches ONE run per target —
attached project environments, or attached named hosts — under a single **server-minted** `runGroupId`, then detaches execution an
d responds `202` with a per-target receipt.\n- [Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refe
rence/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite-author-only-does-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eval suite — the suite record plus its test
cases — and responds `201` **synchronously**, WITHOUT executing anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST
/eval-runs` (passing the returned `suiteId`).\n- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-owned-eval-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create
one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declaredSuiteId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed.
The inspector parses the suite file; this body is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…\n- [Get one eval suite's conf
iguration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings — atta
ched environments, hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the edi
t routes read and write.\n- [Delete an eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Delet
es the suite and its cases. Past runs are not deleted.\n- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md): Partial update — omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state:
a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently
treated as a clear. Responds with the full updated suite.\n- [Get the pre-run disclosure for a suite launch plan](https://docs.mcp
jam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-the-pre-run-disclosure-for-a-suite-launch-plan.md): What happens to a run's content BEFORE you
launch it: which models it calls and where they route, which LLM analyzers/judges can fire and where their evidence goes, capture
/retention/region facts, and the subprocessors engaged. Read-only — never launches or gates a run. Keyed by the SAME destination…\
